## 1. The fly  (`#the-fly`)

Cited ayat: 22:73-74

> **22:73** يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
>
> **22:74** مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

### Claims

**c1** (22:73): The ayah addresses people: a similitude is struck, so listen to it: those you call upon besides God will never create a fly, even if they gathered for it.

**c2** (22:73): If the fly takes something from them, they cannot rescue it from it; weak are the seeker and the sought.

**c3** (22:74): They did not appraise God with His true appraisal; God is strong and mighty.

### One-minute summary

The ayah addresses people with a similitude: those they call upon besides God will never create a fly, even if they gathered for it [c1]. If the fly takes something from them, they cannot rescue it from it [c2].

### Complete story

The ayah addresses people: a similitude is struck, so listen to it [c1]. Those you call upon besides God will never create a fly, even if they gathered for it [c1]. If the fly takes something from them, they cannot rescue it from it [c2]. The ayah says that the seeker and the sought are weak [c2].

The next ayah says that they did not appraise God with His true appraisal [c3]. It adds that God is strong and mighty [c3].

### Deep study

The similitude is introduced as something to be listened to, and its content is statements about those who are called upon besides God [c1][c2]. The words weak are the seeker and the sought close the picture, and the next ayah turns to how God was appraised [c2][c3]. The ayah does not say which one is the seeker and which the sought [c2].

### Kids mode

The ayah says that those people call upon besides God will never create a fly, even if they gathered for it [c1]. If the fly takes something from them, they cannot rescue it [c2]. God is strong and mighty [c3].

### Life lessons (educational interpretation)

Educational interpretation (not scripture): One reading is that the picture sets the creation of a fly beside those who are called upon besides God [c1]. Another reading is that the next ayah closes by saying that they did not appraise God with His true appraisal and that God is strong and mighty [c3].

### What the sources do not establish

- Not established: who those called upon besides God are; the ayah names none.
- Not established: what was taken by the fly or who held it; the ayah says something and does not name it.
- The words the seeker and the sought (al-talib wa-l-matlub) are read in more than one way, since the ayah does not say which is the fly and which the one called upon.
- The ayah itself says that a similitude is struck (duriba mathal).
